ideas.pitch: Real-time edge AI surveillance system detecting PPE violations and manufacturing floor hazards on low-power hardware.
ideas.title: SmartEdge Industrial Safety Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with patterns from successful hardware-adjacent and edge-AI safety systems by using local computer vision processing to minimize latency, highly appealing to industrial judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered smart waste classification unit using computer vision and Arduino microcontrollers to automatically segregate recyclables.
ideas.title: EcoSort Autonomous Bin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an unusual physical build with a live working demo, directly mirroring past robotic classification competition wins.

ideas.pitch: A biomedical IoT telemetry device for tracking patient recovery metrics remotely with edge-computed anomaly detection.
ideas.title: BioLog IoT Post-Op Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles genuine hard engineering in medical telemetry and edge computing, a proven combination that captures top prizes at technical hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An on-device static analysis and code review agent optimized for local neural processing units to ensure secure local builds.
ideas.title: NexusNPU Offline Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard systems engineering by processing code locally without reliance on external cloud APIs, impressing judges with architectural depth.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-secured supply chain verification tool using analog ink signatures and microcontrollers to prevent counterfeiting.
ideas.title: SecureChain Supply Authenticator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical sensor input with cloud validation, standing out through a tangible, hardware-backed security workflow.
